annotations.title: Read a Microsoft Advertising campaign’s LinkedIn profile targeting

description: Read the LinkedIn profile targeting on a Microsoft Advertising campaign: every company, industry, job function, seniority and job title criterion with its bid adjustment and criterion id, read from Microsoft. A profile type Microsoft would not read is named as unread, never reported as none. Read-only, free.
